AboutStudio.sectionTitle: More than a few lines of bio.
AboutStudio.sectionSubtitle: A few things I love doing.
AboutStudio.sectionDescription: Familiar tools, ideas taking shape, and a little room for life.
AboutStudio.toolkitDescription: From backend services to thoughtful interfaces. Finding the right tools, exploring new ones, and enjoying the little details.
AboutStudio.toolkitSummary: The toolkit scrolls upward through Java, Spring Boot, TypeScript, React, Next.js, MySQL, Docker and Git behind a profile code window.
AboutStudio.projectsTitle: Always finding something to tinker with.
AboutStudio.projectsDescription: When something catches my eye, I like trying it myself. Exploring new tools, tweaking little features, or building a passing idea. I enjoy the tinkering along the way.
AboutStudio.projectsSummary: Three colored notes on a dotted idea board connect with a dashed line, from an initial thought to a small experiment and a finished creation.
AboutStudio.lifeDescription: Into vintage cruisers and good music. Sometimes I head out for a ride, catch the breeze, and enjoy the view beyond the screen.
AboutStudio.lifeSummary: A helmeted rider on a black vintage cruiser with a broad tank, low saddle, V-twin engine, large round headlamp and twin rear-facing exhausts, beside a vinyl player showing City of Stars. The live clock shows Beijing time, with a working status Monday through Friday and a resting status on weekends. The player is a visual demo.
AboutStudio.workflowDescription: Catch an idea, build a first version, then make the rough edges a little smoother. One commit further than yesterday.
AboutStudio.workflowSummary: A workflow scrolls through ideas, planning, building, checks, polish, notes, commits and shipping, followed by commit details and a completion notice.
